seconds_target: 約4分（カスタムのスライダー240秒）
budget: Suno 300クレジット以内・購入なし（本人10/28）
trial: まず各種1回（12曲・60見込み）で声・楽器・尺を確かめ、抜粋を本人が試聴してから残り18回

leads.name: アコーディオン（パリのミュゼット風・ゆっくり）
leads.style: A warm, gentle accordion in the foreground, soft Parisian musette color played slowly and tenderly, a simple singing melody with long breathing notes and soft chords, close and intimate, never a fast waltz, never tango, never a saxophone. F major, 80 BPM. Instrumental café jazz lo-fi for a quiet little neighborhood café on a rainy late-autumn afternoon that slowly turns into evening. Soft brushed drums with a gentle, relaxed swing, a warm walking upright bass and soft jazzy chords underneath, gentle tape warmth. Cozy, warm and unhurried, never sleepy, never dramatic. A long, continuous piece that keeps the same easy groove all the way through, with no breakdowns and no dramatic build. It continues in this same way for many minutes. About four minutes, gentle natural ending. No vocals, no humming, no whistling. No rain, no thunder, no café chatter, no cups, no birds, no clock ticking, no field recordings. No dog sounds, no barking.
